zh-CN:
# 语言与翻译维护

Web 面板和 Android App 支持简体中文与 English。首次打开时优先使用浏览器或系统的语言列表；中文和英文之外的语言回退到 English。

登录页和账户菜单的「语言」可以选择「跟随系统」、简体中文或 English。手动选择保存在当前浏览器或 App，不改动其他设备；选择跟随系统后继续使用设备语言。切换语言不更换用户身份或资源权限。

Web 切换时保留当前表单和待确认任务。Android 使用系统应用语言机制刷新页面；提交中的操作应等待结果后再切换。用户填写的站点名称、域名、记录值和对话内容不会自动翻译。

日期和系统控件跟随当前语言。Web 和 App 用 `Accept-Language` 请求服务端提示；来自 Cloudflare、操作系统或模型的外部错误可能仍使用服务自身的语言。

## 翻译资源

`locales/zh-CN.json` 与 `locales/en.json` 是共享词条。业务代码只引用稳定 ID，动态内容使用 `{p0}` 等参数，不拼接两套页面。翻译随构建打包，用户访问时不调用在线翻译服务。

修改词条后运行 `node tools/i18n/generate.mjs`，同步 Android 和后端资源。运行 `node --test tools/i18n/*.test.mjs` 检查词条与占位符。Android 构建也检查生成资源，防止只更新 Web。

## 文档内容

文档以 `docs/content/<页面>.json` 为来源，同一个文件包含 `zh-CN` 和 `en` 的 Markdown 正文。构建生成两种语言页面，页面清单和导航共用。不要直接修改生成的 `docs/guide/` 或 `docs/en/` Markdown。

两种语言的正文仍需要翻译和审核；共同来源消除了重复目录、导航和构建流程，不会自动保证译文准确。运行 `npm run content:generate` 更新本地页面，再运行 `npm run build` 验证链接和搜索索引。
en:
# Language & translation maintenance

The Web panel and Android app support Simplified Chinese and English. On first use, they follow the browser or system language list. Languages other than Chinese and English fall back to English.

Choose Follow system, 简体中文 or English in the sign-in page or account menu. A manual preference is saved in the current browser or app without changing other devices. Choosing Follow system restores device preferences. Language selection does not change identity or resource permissions.

Web switching preserves the current form and pending tasks. Android uses application locales to refresh screens; wait for any in-flight submission to finish before switching. User-supplied site names, domains, record values and conversation content are not automatically translated.

Dates and standard controls follow the selected language. Web and Android send `Accept-Language` for backend messages; errors supplied by Cloudflare, the operating system or the model may retain that service's language.

## Translation resources

`locales/zh-CN.json` and `locales/en.json` are the shared catalogs. Business code references stable IDs; dynamic values use placeholders such as `{p0}` rather than separate page implementations. Translations ship with the build. Visiting the app does not call an online translation service.

After editing catalogs, run `node tools/i18n/generate.mjs` to synchronize Android and backend resources. Run `node --test tools/i18n/*.test.mjs` to check keys and placeholders. Android builds also verify generated resources so Web-only edits cannot silently leave the app behind.

## Documentation content

Documentation is authored in `docs/content/<page>.json`. Each file contains `zh-CN` and `en` Markdown. Builds generate both language routes from one page and navigation manifest. Do not directly edit generated Markdown in `docs/guide/` or `docs/en/`.

Both language sections still require translation and review. The shared source removes duplicate directories, navigation and build workflows; it does not guarantee translation accuracy. Run `npm run content:generate`, then `npm run build` to validate links and search indexes.
